changelog:
zdat-chat-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the automated comment interaction skill for platforms like Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, and Weibo.
- Supports intelligent reply matching using scenario-based keyword analysis.
- High-intent comments are automatically logged to a clue ledger.
- Integrates proactive interaction with built-in daily flow limits to prevent account restrictions.
- Scheduled inspection and automatic reply at set times, with daily interaction report generation.
- Command-line scripts provided for comment review, ledger management, and daily report generation.
